create.name: Chinmaya Mission Toronto (Chinmaya Vedanta Heritage Centre)
create.bio:
Chinmaya Mission Toronto is one of the oldest Chinmaya centres outside India. Swami Chinmayananda first came to the city in 1972, invited by the local Vedanta Society, and on his second visit in 1974 local students formed the mission, with Charlotte Wallman as its first president. Study classes began on the University of Toronto campus, a centre named Chinmaya Shivalaya opened in Unionville in 1998 and moved to Maple in 2003, and since 2011 the mission has been based in Brampton, at what it now calls the Chinmaya Vedanta Heritage Centre. Swamini Shivapriyananda, its resident teacher since 1988, leads it with younger acharyas trained in the Chinmaya tradition.

The teaching is Advaita Vedanta in the line of Swami Tapovan Maharaj, Swami Chinmayananda and Swami Tejomayananda, taught in English through the Gita, the Upanishads and other classic texts. Volunteers run nearly everything, and most activities cost nothing. Adults can join weekly study groups across the Greater Toronto Area and online; children come to Shishu Vihar and Bala Vihar for stories, chanting and values, and young adults meet weekly to discuss the Gita. There is also a Monday Shiva puja, a monthly Hanuman Chalisa, a chanting awards programme, jnana yajnas, family camps and festival gatherings.

free_resources.title: Adult Study Groups
free_resources.description: Ongoing study groups on Vedantic texts held across the Greater Toronto Area and online, open to all and free of charge, with a yearly programme list.

free_resources.title: Bala Vihar and Shishu Vihar
free_resources.description: Weekly two-hour family sessions where children learn values, stories, chants and bhajans, with a playful Shishu Vihar for the youngest. Trial classes are offered.

free_resources.title: Young Adult Classes (CHYK)
free_resources.description: Weekly discussion classes for young adults on texts such as the Bhagavad Gita, focused on self-development and service.

free_resources.title: OM Chanting Program
free_resources.description: A graded programme for children and adults to learn prayers and verses, from daily invocations to the Vishnu Sahasranama and Gita verses, with ribbons and awards along the way.
